title: Intro to Go
line: Slices, structs, errors and goroutines in small Go programs.

project.title: A print shop with three printers
project.brief: Write main.go on your own. A Printer struct with paper left, a Print method that returns an error when the paper runs out, and one goroutine per printer that reports on a channel.
checks: go run . finishes with no error and go vet reports nothing
Printing more pages than the paper left prints an out of paper error
Main prints one summary per printer, received from a channel

lessons.title: Run your first Go program
lessons.goal: Teach a complete beginner to start a module with go mod init, write main.go in VS Code with package main and fmt.Println to print a two-line postcard, and run it with go run.
lessons.passes: go.mod exists and go run . prints both lines of the postcard.

lessons.title: Variables and types
lessons.goal: Teach Go var, the short := declaration, const, int, float64 and fmt.Printf by building a map scale converter that turns centimetres on a map into kilometres on the ground.
lessons.passes: 4.5 cm at a scale of 1 to 50000 prints 2.25 km.

lessons.title: If, for and switch
lessons.goal: Teach Go if, the for loop in its three forms and switch by printing a grade letter table for the scores 50 to 100 in steps of 10.
lessons.passes: Six rows print, from 50 with an F up to 100 with an A.

lessons.title: Functions and multiple returns
lessons.goal: Teach Go functions with typed parameters and multiple return values by writing a seating planner that returns both the full rows and the seats left over.
lessons.passes: 31 people in rows of 6 prints 5 full rows and 1 left over.

lessons.title: Slices
lessons.goal: Teach Go slices, with append, len, slicing and range, by building a waiting queue for a bakery that adds customers and serves from the front.
lessons.passes: After two are served, the queue prints the remaining names in order.

lessons.title: Maps
lessons.goal: Teach Go maps, with the comma ok check, delete and range, by building a capital city lookup that answers for known countries and reports unknown ones.
lessons.passes: France prints Paris and an unknown country prints a not found message.

lessons.title: Structs and methods
lessons.goal: Teach Go structs and methods with value and pointer receivers by building a robot that moves on a grid and reports its position.
lessons.passes: After moving up twice and right once, the robot prints position 1, 2.

lessons.title: Errors
lessons.goal: Teach Go error values, with errors.New, fmt.Errorf and checking err against nil, by writing an age parser with strconv.Atoi that rejects words and negative numbers.
lessons.passes: 42 prints the age, and abc and -5 each print an error message.

lessons.title: Interfaces
lessons.goal: Teach Go interfaces by writing a Notifier interface with email and text message senders and one function that sends through either.
lessons.passes: One function takes a Notifier and both senders print their message.

lessons.title: Goroutines and channels
lessons.goal: Teach Go goroutines, channels and sync.WaitGroup by building a kitchen where three cooks each make a dish at once and report back on a channel.
lessons.passes: Three goroutines send on a channel and main prints all three dishes.
